info.title: Owner workspace counters
info.description: Read-only implemented sidebar counts. Full owner/property scope, independent of list pagination. No payment/state mutation.

get.summary: Read authenticated eligible Owner's scoped counters

parameters.name: propertyId
parameters.description: Omit for all properties owned by the caller. Foreign or nonexistent ID returns 404.

200.description: Counts over all matching records. SENT monthly invoices without a paidAt payment; additional receipts require exact contract owner and customer and no paidAt. ACTIVE contracts must have started; expiration is inclusive today..today+20; expired is endDate<today. Pending renewal does not replace an ACTIVE predecessor until activation. No changes to D-10 renewal command policy.

Error.description: Invalid input, unauthenticated, ineligible/non-Owner or property outside scope; errors are never a valid zero count.

propertyId.description: Selected ID, null for all owned properties.

expiringThrough.description: asOf plus 20 days, matching existing expiry reminder window.

unpaidCount.description: Sum of monthly and exact-party additional counts. Unpaid is not necessarily overdue; excludes drafts, paid records and legacy owner-only receipts.

expiredContractCount.description: Still ACTIVE and already past end date; requires lifecycle handling, not auto release/termination.
